pedido.description: side view, facing right, very short stocky heavy draft-type horse inspired by the Crioulo breed, massive barrel-shaped body that is very wide and very deep, very short thick sturdy legs that are shorter than the depth of the body, short very thick muscular neck, broad wide chest, low heavy stance close to the ground, large heavy head, full thick mane, clearly much lower, wider and heavier than an average horse, same horse redrawn shorter and stockier: much shorter legs, deeper barrel body, thicker neck, racing horse at full gallop, body stretched low, front legs reaching far forward and hind legs pushing far back, jockey crouched low, jockey in yellow (#ffff00) silks and yellow helmet with pink (#ffc0cb) skin, grey (#808080) saddle and saddle pad and reins, long straight flowing mane and tail, bright green (#00ff00) long straight mane and tail clearly visible, jockey in yellow silks and yellow helmet, pure red (#ff0000) coat with dark red (#800000) shading, bright green (#00ff00) mane and tail with dark green (#008000) shading, blue (#0000ff) hooves and muzzle, black outline, flat colors, no gradients, no anti-aliasing
